title: Italian Sausage & Triple Cheddar Quiche
description: A savory quiche with finely crumbled Italian sausage and triple cheddar in a flaky pie crust. The sausage and cheese bring enough salt, so no extra salt is needed.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.
Brown the Italian sausage in a skillet, breaking it into small crumbles. Cook until no pink remains, drain the grease well, then transfer to a cutting board and chop it very fine for an even texture.
Spread the cooked sausage evenly in the crust, then sprinkle the triple cheddar over it.
Whisk eggs, milk, black pepper, and optional garlic powder together. Do not add salt; the sausage and cheese provide plenty. Pour over the filling.
Bake at 375°F until the edges are set and the center is mostly set with just a slight jiggle, about 35 to 45 minutes.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing so the filling finishes setting.

cookSteps.text: HEAT OVEN to 375°F and fit the pie crust into a 9-inch pie pan.

BROWN and crumble:
{{sausage}} Italian sausage

Cook until no pink remains and drain the grease well. Transfer to a cutting board and CHOP VERY FINE for an even texture.

SPREAD IN CRUST:
cooked Italian sausage
{{cheddar}} triple cheddar cheese

WHISK TOGETHER:
{{eggs}} eggs
{{milk}} milk
{{pepper}} black pepper
OPTIONAL: {{garlic}} garlic powder

No added salt is needed. Pour over the filling.
BAKE at 375°F until the edges are set and the center is mostly set with just a slight jiggle. Start checking around 35 minutes.
LET REST before slicing so the filling finishes setting.

storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days. Reheat individual slices until hot.

title: Creamy Crockpot Chicken Broccoli Rice
description: Tender shredded chicken, rice, broccoli, cream cheese, milk, and cheddar cooked into a creamy slow-cooker dinner.

ingredients.item: extra chicken broth, if needed while rice cooks

steps.text: Add the chicken, 2 cups chicken broth, garlic powder, salt, and optional black pepper to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2½ to 3 hours, until the chicken is fully cooked and easy to shred.
Shred the chicken with two forks right in the slow cooker.
Stir in the uncooked rice. Turn the slow cooker to HIGH, cover, and cook 45 to 75 minutes, checking around 45 minutes. If the mixture looks dry before the rice is tender, add up to ¼ cup extra broth.
When the rice is almost tender, stir in the broccoli. Cover and cook 20 to 30 minutes more, until the broccoli and rice are tender.
Turn the slow cooker to LOW or WARM. Stir in the cream cheese, milk, and cheddar. Cover for 10 to 15 minutes, then stir until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve warm.

cookSteps.text:
ADD TO SLOW COOKER:
{{chicken}} boneless chicken
{{broth}} chicken broth
{{garlic}} garlic powder
{{salt}} salt
OPTIONAL: {{pepper}} black pepper

COVER AND COOK until the chicken is fully cooked and easy to shred.
LOW: 4 to 5 hours
OR HIGH: 2½ to 3 hours.
SHRED the chicken with two forks right in the slow cooker.

STIR IN {{rice}} uncooked long-grain white rice.

Turn to HIGH, cover, and cook 45 to 75 minutes. CHECK at 45 minutes. If it looks dry before the rice is tender, add up to {{extraBroth}} extra broth.
WHEN THE RICE IS ALMOST TENDER, stir in {{broccoli}} broccoli florets. Cover and cook until the broccoli and rice are tender.

TURN TO LOW OR WARM. STIR IN:
{{creamCheese}} cream cheese
{{milk}} milk
{{cheddar}} shredded cheddar

Cover briefly, then stir until smooth and creamy.
TASTE, adjust seasoning if needed, and serve warm.

storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days. Freeze cooled individual portions for up to 2 months. Thaw overnight in the refrigerator and reheat gently; add a splash of milk or broth if needed to loosen the sauce.
